text: The blood count shows a concerning pattern of pancytopenia with a very high white blood cell count of 81,000/mm3. speaker: Doctor
text:
The peripheral blood smear reveals immature cells with large nucleoli and characteristic pink, needle-shaped inclusions, which are pathognomonic for Auer rods. Given your history of pancytopenia, severe fatigue, and this specific finding, do you have a history of any previous blood disorders or chemotherapy?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Myeloid Leukemia
